segments.text: The FDA has approved over 863 chemicals in these foods as well as thousands of others and it's
gotten so bad that the state of Texas has demanded that all of these foods must have a warning label
on them that says unfit for human consumption. Most people have absolutely no idea that all
of these foods behind me literally contain hundreds of dangerous chemicals. Parents,
especially please listen. Follow me for more tips. Check out my bio because there's some amazing information up there.
